<!--description-->
Retrieve a Google Secret Manager dotenv secret, mask its values, and export them as environment variables.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name           | Description                     | Required | Default |
|----------------|---------------------------------|----------|---------|
| `oblt-cluster` | The Observability cluster name. | `true`   | ` `     |
<!--/inputs-->

|------|-------------|

## Usage
Grant `id-token: write` so the action can authenticate to Google Cloud through workload identity federation.

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/**" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml
---
name: use-gscm-secret

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  retrieve-secret:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/elastic/gscm-secrets@v1
        with:
          oblt-cluster: observability-ci
      - run: curl --fail "${ELASTICSEARCH_HOST}"
```
<!--/usage-->
